sentences.en: The public is requested not to litter in these woods.
sentences.zh: 公共区域请勿乱扔垃圾。

sentences.en: A lot of people climb the railing, and even litter.
sentences.zh: 很多人翻越护栏，并且还乱丢垃圾。

sentences.en: Horrific hallucinations littered her mind just before she fell asleep.
sentences.zh: 她即将入睡之前脑海中全是可怕的幻觉。

senses.zh: 垃圾；轿，担架；一窝（动物的幼崽）；凌乱
乱丢；给…垫褥草；把…弄得乱七八糟
